title: Two novel Ln8 clusters bridged by CO3 2− effectively convert CO2 into oxazolidinones and cyclic carbonates

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Ln8 cluster bridged by two CO3 2−

synthesis.procedure: Nd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.05 mmol), triethanolamine (H3L; 0.05 mmol, 7.46 mg), 10 mL acetonitrile and 30 μL triethylamine were sealed in a 20 mL glass vial. The mixture was treated with ultrasound for 15 min and heated at 343 K for 48 h. Block-shaped crystals of 1 were obtained upon slow cooling to room temperature.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal; 20 mL sealed glass vial; ultrasound then heating
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: block-shaped crystals obtained upon slow cooling to room temperature

properties.summary: UV-visible spectra of cluster 1 and H3L were recorded at room temperature. Cluster 1 shows a strong absorption near 219 nm assigned to an n→σ* transition, blue-shifted relative to free H3L (~230 nm) due to Ln–ligand coordination. No magnetic data are reported.

The mixture was treated with ultrasound for 15 min and heated at 343 K for 48 h. Block-shaped crystals of 2 were obtained upon slow cooling to room temperature (isostructural to 1).

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: block-shaped crystals obtained upon slow cooling to room temperature

properties.summary: UV-visible spectra of cluster 2 and H3L were recorded at room temperature. Cluster 2 shows a strong absorption near 220 nm assigned to an n→σ* transition, blue-shifted relative to free H3L (~230 nm). No magnetic data are reported.
